titlePlain: CSA, CAD, CIS & CTA: How They Actually
subtitle: Lesson 1 · Certification Pathway Planning

code:
CSA
       (Certified System Administrator)
                     |
        -----------------------------
        |                           |
       CAD                         CIS
 (Application Developer)   (Implementation Specialist —
                             module-specific: CIS-ITSM,
                             CIS-CSM, CIS-HR, CIS-Discovery)
        |                           |
        -----------------------------
                     |
                    CTA
       (Technical Architect — gated by
        real multi-project experience,
        not simply more exams)
caption: CSA is the floor everyone needs; CTA is reachable only after real-world experience.

code:
CSA   -> baseline platform administration
CAD   -> building custom applications
CIS-* -> implementing one specific module
CTA   -> architecting a whole program,
         defended under real questioning
caption: Four letters, four different jobs — not four steps of the same ladder.

steps.label: CSA first
steps.sub: every CIS specialization requires it, and CAD assumes it in practice

steps.label: Branch to CAD or CIS
steps.sub: match the branch to the work you built depth in across Courses 1-13

steps.label: CTA much later
steps.sub: earned through years of real implementation experience, not another exam
